# Arseniy Perel

> AI Product Builder based in Ramat Gan, Israel. I turn ambiguous product and business ideas into working, verifiable systems using AI-assisted development.

Primary professional areas: AI automation, rapid prototyping, agent workflows, AI implementation, API integrations, prompt/workflow design, debugging, verification and product delivery.

Current status: incoming B.A. student at Bar-Ilan University, Multidisciplinary Social Sciences, High-Tech Track. Open to junior, student, part-time and project roles in Israel or remote where practical product building and AI automation matter more than traditional line-by-line software engineering credentials.
